item.title: Indiana Teacher Fired Over Trans Students’ Names Lands $650K Settlement
item.description: An Indiana public school music teacher who claims he was essentially forced out of his job because he wouldn't violate his Christian beliefs and call transgender students by their new names has won a $650,000 payout from the school district that forced him to choose between his religious convictions and his job.
